Hi Irene and Laura,

Quick intro — I wanted to surface Rohan Mehta (cc'd). Rohan is a former colleague from my last startup; he's a strong systems/infra engineer with recent experience building high-throughput RPC infra. He expressed interest in our Software Engineer, Serving role and is available for interviews next week only (travel constraints).

Rohan's resume is attached. Given his timeline, can we prioritize scheduling? Laura — would you take ownership for calendar coordination and send the candidate the available slots? I can help with technical panel suggestions if helpful.

Why prioritize: good referral signal, strong match for the performance-focused work we'll need on the runtime team, and limited availability window (departing on 4/18). If we can lock an initial onsite/loop next week we increase chances of moving quickly.

Thanks —
Marissa Cole

Redwood Inference

Hi Rohan — nice to e-meet you, and thanks Marissa for the intro. I'm Laura, Sr. Talent Partner on the Serving team. I'll own scheduling and next steps.

We have two interview formats that would work given your constraints: a 60-minute technical screen (Vivek + hiring manager) or a shorter 45-minute deep-dive with our infra engineer and follow-up. To move fastest, please pick any two of the slots below that work for you and I'll lock them with the panel:

• Tue Apr 13, 2027 6:00–7:00 PM PDT
• Wed Apr 14, 2027 5:30–6:30 PM PDT
• Thu Apr 15, 2027 9:00–10:00 AM PDT

If none of these work, paste three times you are free and I'll do my best to accommodate. Link to a priority scheduling page (one-time slots we've held for referrals): https://calendly.com/redwood-interviews/30min?slot=priority

I've attached our Interview Packet with suggested topics for the panel and a short pre-read. We typically ask candidates to be prepared to discuss a recent systems design or performance debugging example.

Attachments: Interview_Packet_Redwood.docx

Best,
